title: Water Parks Guide: Indoor and Outdoor Splash Days
description: A family guide to water parks: indoor water parks for rainy days, outdoor parks in Tenerife and Orlando, height limits, what to pack and how to save on tickets.
h1: The family guide to water parks
intro: Water parks are a guaranteed hit with kids and teens. Here’s how to choose one, what to pack and how to keep the cost down.

image.alt: Water slides at a water park

keywords: what to take to a water park
cardText: Indoor vs outdoor parks, height limits, packing and saving.

blocks.title: Scout’s splash tip
blocks.text: Pack a padlock, flip-flops and a waterproof phone pouch, and check slide height limits before you go so nobody’s disappointed.
points: Reapply suncream after every few slides

sections.html: Warm and rain-proof, indoor water parks like Sandcastle in Blackpool, Rulantica in Germany and the pools at Center Parcs work in any season.
Sunshine favourites include Siam Park in Tenerife and Volcano Bay and Typhoon Lagoon in Orlando. Plan around the heat and reapply suncream often.
Book online, check combined tickets with nearby theme parks, and remember your local leisure pool may have flumes and inflatable sessions for much less. Browse water parks.

faqs.q: What should I take to a water park?
faqs.a: Swimwear, towels, flip-flops, suncream, a padlock for lockers, a waterproof phone pouch, water bottles and snacks if allowed.
